Class ClientHandlerVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.control.ClientHandlerVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer
public class ClientHandlerVisitor extends Object implements VirtualServer
visitor that handles all the incoming events from clients after their connection and returns the response that the server has to send in broadcast or to the specific client

    • visit

      public ServerEvent visit(ChooseToResume event)
      Handles the client's decision to resume a previously saved game or start a new one If the client chooses to resume: - Attempts to load the saved game from persistence. - Prepares the game state for resumption (sets SETUP, restores old nicknames and colors). - Returns an event with the list of old players for reconnection. If the client chooses not to resume: - Deletes any saved game data and signals the start of a new game
      Specified by:
      visit in interface VirtualServer
      Parameters:
      event - the resume decision sent by the client
      Returns:
      a ServerEvent indicating the next action (resume game or start new)
